clips.name: hero
clips.narration_text: Welcome to Recourse. The x40 protocol lets agents pay agents, but payments are final with zero delivery verification. Recourse fixes that.
clips.scene_description: Landing hero with badges (EXPLORE + WHAT IT DOES top)

clips.name: primitives
clips.narration_text: Three primitives: onchain escrow locks USDC until delivery is confirmed. AI dispute resolution evaluates evidence at machine speed. KeeperHub executes the settlement onchain.
clips.scene_description: Landing 'What it does' section (3 cards: Escrow / Arbiter / KeeperHub)

clips.name: how
clips.narration_text: Three steps: funds lock in escrow. The AI arbiter reviews cryptographic evidence. KeeperHub settles onchain. No human in the loop.
clips.scene_description: Landing 'How it works' section (3 steps visualization)

clips.name: connect
clips.narration_text: Clicking Launch Demo opens the escrow interface. We connect in Offline Demo mode to simulate the full lifecycle.
clips.scene_description: Launch Demo click → demo.html loads → Offline Demo connect screen

clips.name: create
clips.narration_text: The workspace shows contract addresses on Sepolia, balances, and the escrow creation form. We enter ten USDC, a seller address, and a task description. The contract locks the funds.
clips.scene_description: demo.html 3-column workspace with escrow creation form + fill + create

clips.name: dispute
clips.narration_text: Now we raise a dispute. The escrow freezes. The four-agent pipeline activates.
clips.scene_description: Dispute button click → dispute raised → escrow freezes

clips.name: pipeline
clips.narration_text: Four agents execute in sequence. Evidence verifier checks payload integrity. The AI arbiter, powered by Groq llama-three-three seventy billion, renders a binding verdict. Policy agent approves. KeeperHub broadcasts the onchain transaction.
clips.scene_description: Pipeline visualization showing 4 agents executing in sequence

clips.name: arbiter
clips.narration_text: The arbiter runner shows real Groq LLM output. Scenario one: non-delivery, buyer wins, full refund, confidence one point zero. Scenario two: delivered correctly, seller wins, confidence zero point nine. Source: LLM.
clips.scene_description: Terminal view with Groq LLM arbiter-runner.ts output

clips.name: blockscout
clips.narration_text: Real transaction on Sepolia Blockscout. Block eleven million. resolveDispute called from KeeperHub's wallet. Nine point nine USDC refunded. Status: success.
clips.scene_description: Blockscout Sepolia transaction page showing resolveDispute TX

clips.name: closing
clips.narration_text: Recourse. The agent decides. KeeperHub executes. Built for DoraHacks Agents Onchain.

sync_issues.detail: Narration starts at 38.88s saying 'Clicking Launch Demo' but recording must first smoothScroll from #howitworks back to hero. sync_issues.detail: The recording fills the form via evaluate() which is fast (~0.6s), but the create escrow button click + tx confirmation takes ~8s. By 60s, escrow is created. Narration ends at 61.84s.
sync_issues.impact: OK — narration and visual are roughly aligned

sync_issues.detail: Scene 7 recording just sleeps 17.3s after dispute click. The pipeline UI animation from the dispute must run for the full duration. If animation is faster, there's dead screen time.
sync_issues.impact: Depends on demo.html pipeline animation duration

sync_issues.detail: Real Blockscout URL is loaded with 7s timeout. If network is slow, falls back to HTML card. At 110s, the page is still loading. Full TX details appear at ~115s. Narration ends at 115.44s.
sync_issues.impact: ~5-8s of loading screen before content visible
